note: A locked field (v2 Suggested vs owned): the person wrote Problem themselves, so it is theirs, and the next message invites a rewrite of it. The locked-field figures read this case - how often the model proposed a change to Problem, and whether any change survived the server's drop, which must be never.

draft.title: Digital calibration checklist
draft.problem: Paper calibration checklists get lost, so we have no record of which units were checked.

turns: Actually the bigger issue is that the checklist takes 40 minutes a unit. A tablet app that logs each step automatically would fix both.
